messages:
maya: hey everyone :wave: first-day q — where should I post: laptop delivery/serial, desk setup pics, and a request for a building badge? also, how do i opt into the onboarding bots so I get reminders?
ben: welcome maya! :tada: short cheat: laptop delivery & hardware -> #new-hires (thread your photos), badge/door access -> @sarah (people ops) or #people-ops, desk/perm requests -> #facilities, infra/ssh/setup -> #eng-ops. If it's a one-off question dm the person, but put follow-ups in threads.
maya: great, thanks. for bots, is it a slash command or do I need to opt-in somewhere?
devex-bot: Hi maya — automated onboarding reminders enabled via `/onboard subscribe` or visit https://intranet.redwood/quickstart and click "Enable onboarding bots". You can set frequency to daily/weekly. (This is an automated message.)
ben: subscribing example:```/onboard subscribe --channel=#new-hires --reminder=daily``` after that the bot will DM you checklist items.
leo: etiquette note: please avoid @channel in #new-hires unless it's an org-wide heads-up. Use reactions for ack (e.g., :thumbsup:) and use threads for troubleshooting so the channel stays searchable.
sarah: badge requests — please fill the access form: https://forms.redwood/badge (select "new hire"). Once submitted I'll handle approvals; expect email within 24–48h. If you need same-day access, DM me and mention "urgent".
maya: perfect. one more — where do I post questions about onboarding laptops that fail imaging?
ben: post the initial error in #eng-infra or #eng-ops, include logs and a photo of the screen. Use this minimal template in your thread:```- device serial: XXXX-XXXX
- error messages: copy/paste
- steps tried: e.g., reflash, different USB stick
- availability: timezone windows for swap``` keeps responses quick.
maya: copying that, thanks all :pray:
ben: also point: add your manager and onboarding buddy to the thread so they can track progress. welcome aboard! :confetti_ball:
